scenario_title: Redrive maxReceiveCount 1 sends retries to the DLQ
title: Processing errors on billing-svc

detection.alert: billing-svc: error-log rate > 20/min (CloudWatch Logs metric filter)

impact: Background processing failed; customer-visible data was delayed or wrong on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-05-15 17:07-20:37: billing-svc: 173 of 260 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-05-15 17:07 and 2026-05-15 20:37 UTC (peak error ratio 0.9 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.
error_templates: c.f.b.consumer.UsageEventConsumer - transient error on usage event <*> SocketTimeoutException, leaving it for redelivery
c.f.b.invoice.InvoiceService - invoice <*> total does not match usage records
c.f.b.api.UsageController - account <*> requested usage for a closed period

_templates.macro: Terraform change set maxReceiveCount {old} -> {new}; every transient failure sent usage events straight to the DLQ and invoices were missing usage.

rca.macro: Terraform change set maxReceiveCount 5 -> 1; every transient failure sent usage events straight to the DLQ and invoices were missing usage.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
